kind: CPU-only camera query overhead; not GPU FPS
phase: one follow/orbit guard plus one mounted-camera guard

physics.engine: Rapier 0.21.0 WASM for robot, room furniture and added props
physics.collider: Added props: selected box, convex hull, or up to 48 connected-island convex hulls; budget fallback to box. Legacy fixed surfaces use their actual triangle geometry; merged fence gaps and rotated surfaces remain open.
physics.robot: Reduced-order motor/tyre model coupled to a Rapier base with separate wheel, plate and component hulls; chassis follows terrain pitch and roll; not an articulated-wheel solver
physics.limitations: Compound convex or box colliders approximate visible meshes; fixed legacy meshes use triangle contact. Human controllers are kinematic, and track gates use revolute joints. ToF and depth selection use visual triangle geometry.
